이전 기록과 동일하게 관망 유지. RSI 과매도 진입 및 MACD 약세 수렴 지속은 3일 연속 동일한 흐름.

Three consecutive days of decline (-6.19%, -2.90%, -0.94%) pushed RSI into oversold territory at 32.0. MACD histogram worsened to -1.3741, continuing bearish convergence. Price is near the lower Bollinger Band, indicating potential for further decline.

Maintaining a 'wait and see' approach, consistent with prior records. RSI entering oversold and MACD bearish convergence are ongoing trends from the last three days.
